description: Buy WHOIS privacy (ID protection) for a domain — replaces the registrant's name, address, phone and e-mail in the public WHOIS with the privacy service's own. This is the thing to offer a customer who cares about not being personally listed against their domain. Costs money, charged to the account balance, so top up first with `impreza_topup` if it is short. Not available on every TLD.
name: impreza_domain_id_protection
